messages:
Maya K.: Quick sync — finalizing launch ops for the SparkPlug reference app (OSS) + a 1hr "how we benchmark" webinar. Need owners for: launch post, benchmark narrative, webinar logistics, and inbound lead routing. Can everyone call their bites?
Sam L.: I can own webinar logistics & routing. Proposed date Wed Apr 6 11am PT. Will set up registration (Hopin/Zoom) and HubSpot hook.
Jordan P.: I’ll take the benchmark narrative + results writeup. Plan: include 3 workload scenarios (chat, Q&A embed search, batch embeddings) and a tl;dr perf table + cost per 1M tokens.
Nikita R.: I’ll draft the OSS launch blog + short social posts. Will weave in the benchmark highlights Jordan is producing.
Ash V.: I’ll wire tracking and inbound routing. Need the registration form fields and the UTM scheme. Suggest: utm_source=marketing&utm_campaign=sparkplug_refapp&utm_medium=webinar
Maya K.: Perfect. Jordan — can you give a 1-paragraph headline sentence we can put into Nikita’s post by Tue EOD?
Jordan P.: Yes — sending a draft by Tue 9am. Early preview: "SparkPlug delivers 3–5x lower token cost on short-chat workloads vs baseline, while keeping median latency under 120ms."
Sam L.: Heads up — legal asked for an embargo until we sign off the benchmark reproducibility notes. Can we get those in the docs repo?
Jordan P.: On it. I’ll open a PR against docs/benchmarks with commands, dataset pointers, and run seeds. Link once ready.
Nikita R.: For social/snack posts: short thread + single-image benchmark card + story slide. Draft tweet: 
```
Tweet: SparkPlug refapp is live 🚀 — a tiny starter app to get devs shipping fast. Join our webinar Apr 6 to see how we benchmark inference cost & latency. Register: https://go.redwood.ai/sparkplug_refapp?utm_campaign=sparkplug_refapp
```
Maya K.: Love it. Add CTA to the refapp repo and include a "Quickstart in 5 mins" gif.
Ash V.: For routing: I'll create two HubSpot lists — webinar-registered and refapp-cloners. Webhook will tag contacts with "sparkplug_refapp" and route to product-marketing inbox. Also adding slack notifications to #leads with the form fields: name, email, company, job role, primary use-case.
DevRel-bot: Reminder set — webinar task created: "SparkPlug webinar registration page" — due 2026-04-01.
Sam L.: Will run a 15-min dry run with Jordan and Nikita on Apr 3. Can we lock presenters? 
Maya K.: Presenters: Jordan (benchmarks), Sam (demo + ops), Nikita (product storytelling). Maya will moderate.
Nikita R.: I'll prepare a 5-slide narrative: 1) problem 2) demo 3) benchmark highlights 4) how to adopt 5) CTA + next steps.
Jordan P.: Bench slides will include reproducibility callouts and a small table: 
```
Scenario | Median latency | Cost / 1M tokens
short-chat | 110ms | $12
embed-search | 180ms | $25
batch-embed | 240ms | $8
```
Ash V.: Quick check — do we want to gate the benchmark table behind the blog or publish it in the repo? I vote both: blog highlights + full table in repo with raw output logs.
Maya K.: Agreed. Nikita — we’ll put the summary table in the blog and link to the repo appendix. Jordan — please include run commands and docker image tag in the repo PR.
Sam L.: Logistics: Can marketing ops own the webinar confirmation email + 1-day reminder + 1hr reminder? I’ll draft the templates.
Nikita R.: Draft email copy idea: 
"Thanks for registering — join us Apr 6 to see SparkPlug in action. Add it to your calendar: [link]. Can't make it? We'll send the recording."
Maya K.: Action items: 
- Jordan: benchmark draft & docs PR (due Tue 9am).
- Nikita: blog draft + social assets (due Wed EOD).
- Sam: registration page + invites + dry run scheduling (due Fri).
- Ash: HubSpot lists & webhook + slack routing (due Fri).
DevRel-bot: Task created: "SparkPlug launch checklist" assigned to @Maya K., due 2026-04-01.
Ash V.: One more: can we add a UTM param for creative=bench_card for social card clicks? helps attribution.
Nikita R.: Yep — I'll stitch that into the social links.
Maya K.: Great progress. If anyone hits blockers ping me or drop updates in this thread. Small ask — please call out any embargo constraints ASAP so legal sign-off doesn't delay the blog.
Sam L.: Noted. I'll loop in Legal if Jordan's reproducibility doc contains any sensitive infra details.
Jordan P.: Will redact any private system names and include a small reproducibility checklist instead.
Nikita R.: Putting the first draft in drive: https://docs.google.com/sparkplug-launch-draft (comments open).
Maya K.: Thanks team — wrapping. We’ll reconvene here Tue after Jordan's PR lands. :thumbsup:
